paper_metadata.title: Investigation of microstructure and tribological properties of CoFeNi1.5VZrx eutectic high entropy alloys optimized by tunning Zr content

evidence.quote: This study investigates the influence of Zr on the microstructural evolution, mechanical and tribological properties of CoFeNi1.5VZrx (x = 0 – 0.6) eutectic high entropy alloys (EHEAs).

attributes.morphology: alternating layers of FCC and Laves phases

evidence.quote: When the molar content of Zr was increased to 0.6 (Fig. 4 g – i), the EHEA exhibited a more refined microstructure, comprising alternating layers of FCC and Laves phases. The Laves phase is finer grained than Zr03 EHEA and splits the FCC phase into lamellae with a spacing of about 3 – 6 µ m.
As depicted in Fig. 5 a, the average hardness of the CoFeNi1.5VZrx EHEAs increases almost linearly from 241.4 HV to 799.5 HV as Zr content varies.
